title: pleopeltis polypodioides
intro: Pleopeltis polypodioides, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a type of epiphytic fern species native to tropical regions of the Americas. It is known for its ability to survive in dry conditions and revive when water is available, which is a unique characteristic among plant species. The resurrection fern has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pleopeltis polypodioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
